cases.prompt: Design and implement a compact Nook-style shopping page for a user who wants to find a calm home object, inspect it, save it, and place a simulated order. Search must have a useful no-results recovery, checkout must include a review step, and the confirmed result must remain discoverable after the bag clears. Use Charcoal UI and keep the implementation in candidate.dart.
requiredAssertions: the find-and-buy outcome is visually primary while saved items and account context remain secondary
search, no-results recovery, product detail, bag, review, confirmation, and post-confirmation states are modeled explicitly
saving and bag state are reused across collection, detail, and confirmation rather than duplicated
every interactive state change has immediate feedback and the placed order has persistent feedback
compact layout remains readable without horizontal overflow and controls preserve semantics
forbiddenPatterns: a checkout button that jumps directly to a transient message
fake controls whose labels promise unimplemented behavior
raw component-internal geometry copied into page code

cases.prompt: Design and implement a compact Lumen-style wallet page for a user who needs to understand an available balance and safely send money. Balance privacy, inline amount validation, an explicit transfer review, confirmation, and durable activity history must all work in the local simulation. Use Charcoal UI and keep the implementation in candidate.dart.
requiredAssertions: available balance and recent movement precede secondary money actions in the information hierarchy
recipient and amount validation preserve the draft and explain how to recover
editing, invalid, review, submitting or immediate completion, receipt, and activity states are coherent
confirmation updates both the balance and a durable activity record
focused transfer steps do not falsely select or expose unrelated top-level destinations
forbiddenPatterns: money is sent from the first edit screen without a review state
success exists only as a toast or temporary string
duplicated transfer fields with independent state owners

cases.prompt: Design and implement a compact Daylight-style wellness page for a user completing three gentle daily habits. The checklist should feel breathable, show reversible progress, reveal tomorrow planning only after completion, save that plan, and show it persistently in a Journey view. Use Charcoal UI and keep the implementation in candidate.dart.
requiredAssertions: today completion is the primary intent and tomorrow planning is progressively disclosed
habit label, supporting cue, streak context, and checked state form one reusable tappable item composition
incomplete, partial, complete, reopened, planning, saved, and journey states remain internally consistent
unchecking one habit reverses only that habit and removes premature completion actions
the compact checklist has deliberate vertical breathing room without applying the same density to unrelated pages
forbiddenPatterns: Plan tomorrow navigates directly to Journey without an editable and saved plan state
separate tap targets for the checkbox and its descriptive item content
dense task rows copied from a backlog or settings list
